FAQS.q: Do I need to create an account to try this?
FAQS.a: This page is a public demo — no account needed. When you're ready to create your own profile, sign up for free. No credit card required.
Yes. The free plan gives you a personal profile, QR code, and basic links — forever free. Paid plans add business profiles, analytics, email signatures, and more.

FAQS.q: Can I use this for my business?
FAQS.a: Absolutely. The Business Profile plan gives you a full business page with services, gallery, team, FAQs, and reviews — everything a customer needs to find and trust you.

FAQS.q: How do I share my profile?
FAQS.a: You get a unique link (e.g. japrofilestudio.jagroupservices.co.uk/profile/yourname), a QR code you can download, and an NFC-ready format. Share it anywhere.
Yes. Profile Centre is operated by JA Group Services Ltd, a UK-registered company. Your data is stored securely in the UK and processed in line with UK GDPR.
